basis.quote: Given a local or remote event, a non-controller, non-witness, non-delegator validator MUST first verify the event's controller signatures, witness signatures (if witnessed), and delegator anchoring seal (if delegated) before it can accept that event into its copy of that event's KEL.
basis.text: Interoperability with keripy 1.x, not conformance: the reading the suite's KERI decision procedure (docs/design.md, KERI) gives a KERI 1.0 body with keripy 1.x's field set, where keri-v1.0.1 would grade the same reading SHOULD, inferred under the quoted sentence. description: An inception and an interaction, then a different interaction at the same sequence number, also signed by the current key. A second interaction cannot supersede the first (rule A2), so a validator should not accept it, and its key state stays at the first interaction. Built on keripy 1.x's wire: KERI 1.0 bodies with keripy 1.x's field sets and CESR 1.00 attachments, mirroring KERI-0042 (KS-59) in keri-v1.0.1.
title: keripy 1.x: conflicting interaction, validly signed
